Which American presidents were in office during the Vietnam War?
results.query:
SELECT ?president WHERE {
  ?termOfOffice dbo:startYear ?startYear .
  ?termOfOffice dbo:endYear ?endYear .
  FILTER(?startYear <= YEAR(dbr:Vietnam_War) && ?endYear >= YEAR(dbr:Vietnam_War))
  ?termOfOffice dbo:incumbent ?president .
  ?president a dbo:President .
}
